scenario_text:
Orders come in through the website all day, but we don't take payment at the
time. They pile up and a run goes through them overnight to charge the card
and book stock, then each customer gets an email the next morning telling them
what happened. The website itself is straightforward — around 40 people
ordering at once at peak, roughly 20 GB of order history. Each order is
read once by the overnight run and rarely looked at again. Host is 8 GB RAM,
4 vCPU, and we need nightly backups.
